cases.question: Why does the Transformer use positional encodings?
cases.expected_output: Without recurrence or convolution, the model needs positional information to represent sequence order.

cases.question: How does this model know which token comes first?

cases.question: Why scale the attention dot products?
cases.expected_output: Scaling counters large dot products that can push softmax into regions with very small gradients.

cases.question: Why is decoder self-attention masked?
cases.expected_output: Masking prevents attention to later output positions so predictions depend on previously known outputs.
